old_draft_plan.scope: Separately preregistered 1024-sample confirmation of unchanged engine revisions; retains original failed 64-sample study
old_draft_plan.compiler: Rust 1.99.0, opt-level 3 test profile, debug 0, default features, jobs 2
old_draft_plan.stale_changes: Replace IDs 0..16, delete IDs 16..24, insert IDs 8192..8200; writer replaces already-uncovered ID 0 once per query
old_draft_plan.writer_protocol: Preconstruct replacement; query signals writer at canonical scoring entry without waiting; measure acquisition wait and complete insert; immutable pre-query full-scan oracle checked after every sample
old_draft_plan.memory: Query-thread allocator calls and peak net requested bytes while rank_vector_snapshot runs; excludes corpus, writer allocations, output serialization, and allocator metadata/RSS
old_draft_plan.preimplementation_diagnostic: One baseline process, after explicit quiet signal and before production edits; retained separately and excluded from paired comparisons

acceptance.correctness: Every complete ordered (document ID, chunk index, canonical score bits) list equals a coherent brute-force oracle; deterministic paused-scoring writer test and delta/bitmap boundaries pass
acceptance.writer: Median per-process writer lock-wait p50 decreases at least 50% at dimensions 128 and 768
acceptance.query: Median per-process query p50 and p99 increase no more than 15% for fresh_idle and stale_idle at each dimension; concurrent query latency reported without hiding tradeoffs
acceptance.allocation: Additional stale capture remains bounded by 512 KiB bitmap plus 128 document Arcs and at most 1024 scored delta hits; no embedding or document-text copy
acceptance.limits: Local synthetic fixed workload on a shared desktop, conditional on all host checks; no production/general-hardware claim. Preserve original failed study. No tuning, automatic reruns or selective exclusions.

old_draft_plan.source_pinning: Current source SHA is filled after implementation and correctness checks, before its build and first paired sample; no acceptance/workload changes after diagnostic

query_schedule.writer_versions: Original index+2 progression continues through 1032 iterations; query vectors alone repeat the original 64 recorded vectors.

original_study.query_gate: failed: fresh 16D median-process empirical p99 +24.6216%; never superseded or erased

old_draft_plan.confirmation_reason: Original nearest-rank p99 with 64 samples is the maximum, with external CPU activity observed; 1024 samples place p99 at the eleventh-largest sample. This is not an original-plan retry.
old_draft_plan.binary_change: Existing binaries hardcode 8+64 iterations. Rebuild unchanged engine revisions with the same scoring instrumentation and only harness sample-count/query-schedule changes; preserve both original and new binary hashes.

host_conditions.exclusions: Only this harness PID, its descendants (including the active probe and ps collector), and its exact ancestor PIDs; never unrelated children of ancestors.
host_conditions.inconclusive_if: Any observed non-excluded process CPU >=25%, any non-excluded build executable, failed process observation, missing/failed process, expired execution budget, or missing quiet grant. Preflight violation prevents measurement; in-run violation stops after the active process and retains partial evidence. No exclusions or automatic retries.
host_conditions.limitation: Sampled ps CPU/load observations cannot prove complete isolation or rule out activity between observations; unrelated jobs are never stopped.

reason: Coordinator review: ps 100% represents one logical core; a 25% per-process cutoff does not describe total host capacity. Replace before measurement with <=20% aggregate external CPU capacity across 10 logical cores, plus coordinated no WARM builds/tests. Confirmation is for increased tail sample precision; no outcomes observed.
